description:
Enable the SSL website feature for the virtual server 'acmecorp.test' and generate a self-signed SSL certificate with the following organizational details:

- Organization Name: Acme Corporation
- Organizational Unit: Web Services
- City/Locality: San Francisco
- State/Province: California
- Country Code: US
- Validity Period: 365 days

The virtual server acmecorp.test currently does not have SSL enabled. You need to:
1. Enable the SSL website feature for acmecorp.test
2. Generate a new self-signed SSL certificate with the exact organizational details listed above
3. Ensure the website is accessible over HTTPS after configuration

Use the Virtualmin web interface (https://localhost:10000) to complete this task. Login credentials: root / GymAnything123!
